body: Release opened as PR 201, branch chore/release-6-0-0, two commits: 1ca5d13b bumps package.json, .claude-plugin/plugin.json and package-lock.json to 6.0.0, and a11b7499 names the landed field in park_thread's published description. Not merged; CI in flight. Major because focus left the resume_thread and update_thread published input schemas and three schema fields became required.U+000AU+000ARECEIPTS AS REPORTED. typecheck exit 0. npm test 814 pass, 0 fail, 0 cancelled, neither known intermittent firing. cutover.manifests-agree passed inside that run, confirming both manifests and the wire serverInfo.version all read 6.0.0. The declared receipt node --test test/contract/published-schema.test.ts test/contract/budget.test.ts was staged deliberately: untouched exit 0 at 43 pass, description changed alone exit 1 at 40 pass and 3 fail, all three edits applied exit 0 at 43 pass. The three intermediate failures were production-registry-census-is-populated-and-consistent, claims.every-published-claim-is-reachable and claims.park-thread-summary-fields-are-reachable, each raising census halted on an unclassifiable item.U+000AU+000AMY BRIEF WAS WRONG IN THREE PLACES AND THE LEAD CAUGHT ALL THREE. It claimed the receipt is red before the description change; it is green, because the pinned phrase matches the old prose, and it only goes red once the description moves alone. It cited 38 pass where the two-file run is 43. And it carried a genuine internal contradiction: fan out reviewers after pushing, and also hand back the moment the PR opens without dispatching and waiting. Those cannot both hold, because a reviewer child does not survive the parent's turn ending. The lead resolved for the handback and said so rather than silently dropping one. No code review ran on this two-file diff; its whole content is one prose string and its pinned copy.U+000AU+000ATWO TOOL FACTS WORTH KEEPING. pr-create requires every --what value to start with a capital letter, which is not in the documented field rules; the first invocation exited 2 on it. And a branch already checked out in another worktree cannot be checked out again, so the replacement lead pushed with git push origin HEAD:chore/release-6-0-0 instead.U+000AU+000ATHE PARK_THREAD ARGUMENT COUNT WAS MISSTATED IN MY BRIEF. The writers unit added one argument to park_thread, not four. The four it added are spread across three tools: park_thread.landed, open_thread.artifacts, update_thread.artifacts_add and update_thread.artifacts_retire. Each of the other three still carries its own ARGUMENT_GAPS entry; only park_thread's was closed here.
